test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He presides ________ all important meetings.
solution:
The correct answer is '**over**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**over**" is used to indicate authority or control in the context of presiding.
 
• The verb "presides" generally collocates with the preposition "over" when referring to meetings or assemblies.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect or do not fit the sentence context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He presides **over**__ all important meetings."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "at"** is incorrect because "presides" does not collocate with "at" in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "on"** is incorrect because "on" does not convey the idea of authority or control.
 
• **Option 4: "with"** is incorrect because "with" implies association rather than leadership or authority.
